response.text:
I can do that — before I add it to the calendar I need a couple quick confirmations:

1) Which Tuesday do you mean (date)? e.g., "next Tuesday (MM/DD)" or a specific date.  
2) Does “4” mean 4:00 PM in Singapore (SGT) or 4:00 PM in Chicago (CDT)? I’ll set the event time-zone explicitly once you confirm.  
3) Attendee info: what email should I invite for the external auditor? Any other attendees to include?  
4) Event details: confirm title (e.g., "Intro with external auditor"), duration 30 minutes — OK? Do you want a video link (Zoom/Teams) added or just a calendar invite?  
5) Send now? I will send the invite immediately after you confirm.

Reply with those items and I’ll create the event.
